summary: Out-of-order edge postbacks produce negative hourly delta and missing compensating credit on March invoice
description:
Issue summary: Customer noticed a negative hourly usage line for 2026-03-09 on their provisional invoice and a missing compensating credit that should have nullified the negative delta. Impact: VectorSearch.ai saw an unexpected -1,842 token delta (negative usage) in the hourly accumulator for their org during the 03/09 02:00-03:00 UTC window. The invoice preview did not include the expected compensating credit; accounting reports show a missing credit-line which will drive a customer support SLA escalations if not corrected before month-end.

Environment: production, dedicated capacity in us-west-2, edge collectors enabled for region-level ingestion.

Steps to reproduce / observed sequence: 1) Edge collector A in us-west-2 reported postbacks for org 67890 at 02:02, 02:07, 02:12 UTC. 2) Regional collector B replayed delayed postbacks with earlier timestamps (01:58, 02:01) due to a short SQS requeue incident. 3) Ingestor applied the late postbacks out-of-time with the hourly accumulator which first recorded higher usage then received older smaller deltas, producing a net negative hourly delta of -1,842 tokens. 4) The automated credit engine detects negative accumulator deltas and normally generates a 'compensating credit' job; in this case the job was suppressed by a heuristic that filters sub-hour late-arrival corrections to avoid double-credits. 5) Result: negative usage persisted in hourly table and did not appear as a zeroed line with a credit on the invoice preview.

Expected behavior: Late-arriving postbacks should be reconciled to the hourly accumulator and, if they produce a negative delta, the billing pipeline should either normalize the delta to zero and emit a compensating credit line or route the correction to the retroactive-credit pipeline so the customer's invoice reflects no negative usage without manual intervention.

Actual behavior: Negative delta remains and compensating credit is missing on invoice preview. Accounting export and customer-facing invoice diverge.

Attachments / logs: s3://redwood-logs/postbacks/2026-03-09/collector-usw2.log.gz, s3://redwood-logs/ingestor/replay-2026-03-09-02.tar.gz, billing-run-2026-03-09-preview.csv, customer-report-vectorsearch-67890-2026-03-09.pdf
investigation_notes:
Initial triage (03/10): Billing triage confirmed negative hourly delta in hourly_accumulator table for org_id 67890 for bucket 2026-03-09T02:00Z. Postback ingestion trace shows out-of-order writes; ingestion service metrics show SQS requeues ~02:00-02:15 UTC localized to collector B.

Hypothesis 1: Late postback replay caused accumulator to subtract tokens (correct behavior for ordering) but the credit engine heuristic suppressed generating a compensating credit because the correction window < 30m (suppression threshold).
Hypothesis 2: Retro-credit pipeline backfill job failed for this org due to a null org mapping error (seen in backfill job logs).

Partial findings: - Ingestor logs confirm two late postbacks with timestamps older than the bucket boundary but delivered after accumulator flush. - Credit engine suppression rule matched a case id and recorded suppression_flag=true. - Backfill job retry logs show error 'org_mapping_id:null' for job run at 03/10T06:00Z.

Next steps (assigned): 1) SRE to validate and fix SQS dead-letter behavior for collector B (Luis). 2) Billing engineer to temporarily run retro-credit backfill for org 67890 after correcting mapping (Priya). 3) Product to review suppression heuristic window and edge-case scope (Evan).
resolution: Investigating — temporary mitigation planned: apply one-off retro-credit for VectorSearch.ai (pending mapping fix) and re-run retro-credit backfill for 2026-03-09 hourly buckets. Longer-term: plan to add a guardrail to the suppression heuristic to not drop compensating credits when a negative accumulator delta > 0 occurs, and add an alert on negative hourly deltas > 500 tokens. Estimated ETA for one-off credit application: 2026-03-15.
resolution_notes: 03/11 Priya: Identified mapping null root cause in backfill job; patch submitted to fix null handling (PR linked). 03/12 Luis: SQS requeue root cause traced to soft failure in collector B when Redis transient spike caused visibility timeout extension; collector patched to extend visibility and reduce requeues. 03/14 Billing: One-off retro-credit drafted and queued for manual approval; awaiting finance sign-off to push to invoice system.
